settings.heading: The questions we get asked most.

settings.question: How quickly will it arrive?
settings.answer: Order by 3pm on a working day and it's dispatched from our Yorkshire workshop that same day, with you the next. Delivery is free on UK orders over £40. Nothing is drop-shipped from overseas, so there are no three-week waits.

settings.question: What does delivery cost?
settings.answer: Delivery is free on UK orders over £40. Below that a delivery charge is calculated at checkout before you pay, so you always see it before you commit.

settings.question: What if my dog just won't use it?
settings.answer: Then it goes back and you're not out of pocket. Let your dog sleep on it for up to 100 nights. If it isn't the bed for them, contact us inside that window and we'll arrange the return and refund every penny. You can read the full terms in our returns policy.

settings.question: Does the bed have to be unused to come back?
settings.answer: No. The whole point of a 100-night trial is that your dog sleeps on it. Send it back slept-on, hair and all.

settings.question: What is covered by the 5-year guarantee?
settings.answer: The foam. It covers the core losing its structure under normal use, which is the failure that ends most dog beds. Covers, zips and liners are wearing parts and sit outside it. The full terms are in our returns policy.

settings.question: How do I start a return?
settings.answer: Contact us through the contact page with your order number and we'll arrange collection. You do not need to keep the original packaging.

settings.heading: Worst case, you have one delivery to wait in for.
settings.lede: Best case, they stop struggling to get up in the morning.
settings.fine_print: 100-night sleep trial · 5-year foam guarantee · Free UK delivery over £40
